name: Eldorado Peak
blurb: Queen of the Cascade River. A brutal approach, a vast icecap and a summit ridge as narrow as a sidewalk.
permit: North Cascades NP backcountry permit for overnight trips. No parking pass needed on the Cascade River Road.

routes.name: East Ridge
routes.grade: Grade II · glacier, exposed snow arête
routes.summary: 6,700 ft of gain in under five miles: forest, talus, two glaciers, then the famous knife-edge.
skills: Balance on a narrow snow crest
Off-trail approach with a heavy pack

waypoints.name: Inspiration Glacier camp
waypoints.note: Rock island at the edge of the icecap, with a toilet. One of the great camps in the range.

sections.note: Cross the North Fork Cascade River on logs, then a relentless climbers path and a half-mile boulder field.
Heather and snow to a notch; drop a class 3 gully into Roush Creek basin.
Eldorado Glacier to the flats of the Inspiration.
East Ridge. The last 200 ft is a true knife-edge with long drops both sides.

pois.name: North Fork Cascade River
pois.note: Log crossing at the very start. Dangerous at high water.

pois.name: Knife-edge arête
pois.note: A boot-width snow crest with long drops on both sides.
